title: pricing-packaging-scratchpad-jamie
content:
Notes / scratchpad — pricing + packaging back-of-envelope
Owner: Jamie Park (product)
Collaborators: Avery Chen (finance), Riley Morgan (platform)
Date: 2025-10-12 -> updated 2025-12-02

Purpose:
- Quick unit-econ estimates for generation and embedding workloads.
- Surface tier ideas and sanity-check margins vs expected infra cost.
- List assumptions + TODOs to validate with bench and infra team.

ASSUMPTIONS (quick & conservative)
- Model mix (hosted API): 70% small/ft models (fast), 25% medium, 5% large/expensive.
- Average tokens per request (generation): 1,000 tokens output + 200 tokens prompt = 1,200 tokens total. (we'll parameterize later)
- Embeddings requests: avg 1,024 tokens processed per call (batch of docs) but priced per embedding unit.
- GPU amortized cost (avg across fleet, after utilization, scheduling): $3.00 / GPU-hour (apportioned).
- Average online throughput per GPU (mixed batch + streaming): 50 tokens/sec sustained.
  - tokens/hr per GPU = 50 * 3600 = 180,000 tokens/hr.
- Infra overhead (network, control plane, storage, cache, infra SRE, monitoring, egress): add 1.8x multiplier to raw GPU cost.
- Sales/Support/SG&A allocation: add 1.6x multiplier after infra costs (so total multiplier ~2.88x on raw GPU cost).
- Target gross margin: 40% (post-infra+opex).

RAW GPU COST PER TOKEN (base)
- GPU cost per token = $3.00 / 180,000 = $0.0000167 per token.
- Raw GPU cost per 1M tokens = 1,000,000 * 0.0000167 ≈ $16.7

TOTAL COST PER 1M TOKENS (incl infra + SG&A)
- infra multiplier 1.8 -> infra-inclusive cost per 1M = $16.7 * 1.8 ≈ $30.1
- plus SG&A multiplier 1.6 -> total cost per 1M = $30.1 * 1.6 ≈ $48.2
- round conservatively -> $50 per 1M tokens as "all-in cost" for mixed model.

PRICE SUGGESTION (hosted API, list price)
- If target gross margin = 40%, price per 1M tokens = cost / (1 - margin) = $50 / 0.6 ≈ $83.3 -> round to $85 per 1M tokens.
- Equivalent per 1k tokens = $0.085 per 1k tokens.

Sensitivity checks:
- If avg throughput lower (25 tokens/sec) -> raw GPU cost per 1M doubles to ~$33.4 -> all-in ~ $100 per 1M -> suggested price ~$170 per 1M.
- If overhead multipliers are optimistic (infra 2.5x, SG&A 2.0x) -> all-in ~ $83 -> price at 40% margin ~$140 per 1M.

Embeddings (different profile)
- Embedding models are cheaper compute per call but are memory/CPU heavy for indexing. Typical throughput: 2500 embeds/sec per embedding worker at small size (approx).
- Assume cost per 1k embeddings ~ $0.005 infra (wild guess) -> map to token equivalent is messy.
- Recommendation: keep embeddings priced per 1k embeddings or per 1k input tokens separately.

Tier ideas (hosted API)
- Free / Starter: 100k tokens / month free (trial), throttled to 5 tps, basic support.
- Developer (pay-as-you-go): $20 / month + $85 per 1M tokens (no commitment).
  - Example: 1M tokens usage => $105/month effective.
- Startup (monthly): $499 / month incl 6M tokens at discounted rate (20% off list) -> list value 6M * $85 = $510 -> customer price $499 gives small benefit + volume certainty.
- Business (committed): $2,500 / month for 50M tokens (committed) = implied $50 / 1M (large committed discount), SLA, faster quota increases, SSO, audit logs.
- Enterprise (Dedicated/Private): custom pricing; reserved capacity with baseline committed $Xk/mo, includes dedicated GPU pools, higher SLOs. Offer per-token price down to $20-$30 per 1M depending on commit and on-premises cost.

Notes on discounts and commitments
- We can offer committed-volume discounts that map to lower effective per-1M price: 10% @ $10k/mo, 30% @ $50k/mo, 60% @ $200k/mo (numbers illustrative).
- Dedicated customers should have a base platform fee + per-token or per-GPU-hour billing to reflect wasted reserved capacity.

Edge cases / operational levers to reduce cost
- Prefix and KV caching: cache common prompt prefixes to reduce model compute for deterministic parts. If cache hits = 30% of token volume -> effective token cost drops ~30%.
- Quantization / smaller model fallback for low-criticality requests -> enable routing policy: 60% to small quantized, 30% medium, 10% gold model. This materially improves blended unit cost.
- Batching: increase effective throughput by 1.5-2x for high concurrency workloads -> lower per-token GPU cost.

Open questions / TODOs
- Validate throughput (tokens/sec) per GPU for our common model variants (ft-small, ft-medium, ft-large). Action: bench jobs with serving-runtime team (JIRA: JIRA-PRIC-120).
- Get infra cost breakdown from finance: actual amortized GPU cost, network, control plane, SRE allocation. (Avery)
- Embedding unit pricing: define a consistent metric (per 1k tokens processed vs per embedding). Need empirical cost.
- Evaluate latency-sensitive pricing (premium for low-latency reserved slots).
- Decide whether to include egress/data transfer in token price or bill separately (esp. enterprise).

Quick mental checks
- If we price at $85 / 1M tokens, a mid-sized app doing 50M tokens/month pays ~$4,250/mo -> seems reasonable for many startups.
- Competitor reference: some managed APIs charge ~$100-$200 / 1M for higher-quality models; our $85 is defensible if performance same or better.

Suggested next steps (short list)
1) Run microbench for 3 model classes (small/med/large) to get tokens/sec and GPU-hour per 1M tokens. (owner: Jamie -> serving-runtime)
2) Finance to provide per-GPU-hour amortized cost including discounting & reserved infra (owner: Avery).
3) Produce a pricing matrix (sheet) that maps model class mix -> blended cost & recommended list price (owner: Jamie).
4) Draft PRD for Developer + Startup tiers with usage examples and churn assumptions (owner: product).

Random notes / scraps
- Consider volume-based auto-upgrades: when monthly usage > X, offer canary migration to Dedicated with projected savings.
- For Dedicated: bill base platform fee (cover control plane) + reserved GPU hours + overage per GPU-hour.
- Put a note in pricing doc to exclude experimental / academic credits from billing metrics.

-- END scratchpad --
